These samples are selected from 6 categories (Strong increase, Strong decrease, Transient peak then drop, Rebound / fluctuating, Persistent high, Stable low)

```{r helper-functions}
# ===============================
# Helper functions
# ===============================

first_non_missing <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  return(as.character(x[1]))
}

clean_molecular_subtype <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\u2212", "-")  # unicode minus to normal hyphen
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "–", "-")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "—", "-")

  case_when(
    x == "HR+/HER2-" ~ "HR+/HER2-",
    x == "HR+/HER2+" ~ "HR+/HER2+",
    x == "HR-/HER2+" ~ "HR-/HER2+",
    x == "HR-/HER2-" ~ "HR-/HER2-",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}

clean_histology <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)

  case_when(
    is.na(x) | x == "" ~ "other",
    x == "Ductal" ~ "Ductal",
    x == "Lobular" ~ "Lobular",
    x %in% c("Mixed Ductal and Lobular", "Mixed") ~ "Mixed Ductal and Lobular",
    x %in% c("Missing", "Unknown", "NA", "nan", "None") ~ "other",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
}

extract_patient_from_cnr <- function(x) {
  basename(x) %>%
    str_remove("\\.annotated\\.cnr$") %>%
    str_extract("^[^-]+")
}

extract_sample_from_cnr <- function(x) {
  basename(x) %>%
    str_remove("\\.annotated\\.cnr$")
}

extract_draw_num <- function(x) {
  nb <- str_extract(x, "NB[0-9]+")
  as.numeric(str_remove(nb, "NB"))
}

# ===============================
# Collapse multiple segment-level calls within one sample-gene
# Important:
# This does NOT collapse across longitudinal samples.
# It only handles cases where the same gene appears in multiple CNR rows/bins
# within the same sample.
# ===============================

collapse_sample_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(x))
  x <- x[x != ""]

  if (length(x) == 0) return("NEUT")
  if (all(x == "NEUT")) return("NEUT")

  gain_states <- c("GAIN", "AMP", "HLAMP")
  loss_states <- c("HETD", "HOMD")

  # same sample/gene contains both gain-side and loss-side events
  if (any(x %in% gain_states) & any(x %in% loss_states)) return("MIXED")

  # strongest gain-side state
  if ("HLAMP" %in% x) return("HLAMP")
  if ("AMP"   %in% x) return("AMP")
  if ("GAIN"  %in% x) return("GAIN")

  # strongest loss-side state
  if ("HOMD"  %in% x) return("HOMD")
  if ("HETD"  %in% x) return("HETD")

  return("NEUT")
}
```

```{r selected-patients}
# ===============================
# Read selected representative patients
# ===============================

selected_patients <- read_csv(selected_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Patient_Identifier = as.character(Patient_Identifier)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Patient_Identifier), Patient_Identifier != "") %>%
  distinct(Patient_Identifier)

selected_ids <- selected_patients$Patient_Identifier

cat("========== Selected representative patients ==========\n")
cat("Number of selected patients:", length(selected_ids), "\n\n")
print(selected_ids)
```

```{r find-matching-cnr-files}
# ===============================
# Find all annotated CNR files matching selected Patient_Identifier
# Example:
# ARWN-NB4.annotated.cnr
# Patient_Identifier = ARWN
# sample_id = ARWN-NB4
# ===============================

all_cnr_files <- list.files(
  cnr_dir,
  pattern = "\\.annotated\\.cnr$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cnr_manifest <- tibble(
  cnr_file = all_cnr_files,
  file_name = basename(all_cnr_files),
  sample_id = map_chr(all_cnr_files, extract_sample_from_cnr),
  Patient_Identifier = map_chr(all_cnr_files, extract_patient_from_cnr)
) %>%
  mutate(
    draw_num = map_dbl(sample_id, extract_draw_num),
    draw_sort = if_else(is.na(draw_num), Inf, draw_num)
  ) %>%
  filter(Patient_Identifier %in% selected_ids) %>%
  arrange(Patient_Identifier, draw_sort, sample_id)

matched_ids <- unique(cnr_manifest$Patient_Identifier)
missing_ids <- setdiff(selected_ids, matched_ids)

cat("========== CNR matching summary ==========\n")
cat("Selected patients:", length(selected_ids), "\n")
cat("Selected patients with CNR files:", length(matched_ids), "\n")
cat("Selected patients missing CNR files:", length(missing_ids), "\n")
cat("Total longitudinal CNR files included:", nrow(cnr_manifest), "\n\n")

cat("Patients missing CNR files:\n")
print(missing_ids)

cat("\nCNR sample count per matched patient:\n")
cnr_manifest %>%
  count(Patient_Identifier, name = "n_cnr_samples") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_cnr_samples), Patient_Identifier) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

cat("\nCNR files included:\n")
cnr_manifest %>%
  select(Patient_Identifier, sample_id, draw_num, file_name) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

if (nrow(cnr_manifest) == 0) {
  stop("No matching CNR files found for selected Patient_Identifier values.")
}
```

```{r clinical-annotation}
# ===============================
# Read clinical metasheet annotation
# ===============================

clinical_df <- read_excel(clinical_file) %>%
  mutate(
    Patient_Identifier = as.character(Patient_Identifier),

    # Convert AUP-ARWN-NB4 to ARWN-NB4
    sample_id = as.character(Collaborator_sample_id),
    sample_id = str_remove(sample_id, "^AUP-"),

    Histological_subtype = as.character(Histological_subtype),
    Molecular_subtype = as.character(Molecular_subtype),
    Tumor_Fraction = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Tumor_Fraction))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Patient_Identifier, sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    Histological_subtype = first_non_missing(Histological_subtype),
    Molecular_subtype = first_non_missing(Molecular_subtype),
    Tumor_Fraction = suppressWarnings(mean(Tumor_Fraction, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Tumor_Fraction = if_else(is.nan(Tumor_Fraction), NA_real_, Tumor_Fraction),
    Histology_group = clean_histology(Histological_subtype),
    Molecular_subtype_clean = clean_molecular_subtype(Molecular_subtype)
  )

sample_annot <- cnr_manifest %>%
  left_join(
    clinical_df,
    by = c("sample_id", "Patient_Identifier")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Histology_group = if_else(is.na(Histology_group), "other", Histology_group),
    Molecular_subtype_clean = if_else(is.na(Molecular_subtype_clean), "Unknown", Molecular_subtype_clean),
    Tumor_Fraction_percent = Tumor_Fraction * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(Patient_Identifier, draw_sort, sample_id)

cat("========== Annotation summary for plotted samples ==========\n\n")

cat("Histology groups:\n")
print(table(sample_annot$Histology_group, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nMolecular subtype groups:\n")
print(table(sample_annot$Molecular_subtype_clean, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nSamples without clinical Tumor_Fraction annotation:\n")
sample_annot %>%
  filter(is.na(Tumor_Fraction)) %>%
  select(Patient_Identifier, sample_id, file_name) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r read-cnr-and-use-corrected-call}
# ===============================
# Read CNR files and use sample-specific Corrected_Call directly
# Example column:
# ARWN-NB4.Corrected_Call
# ===============================

read_one_cnr <- function(cnr_file, sample_id, patient_id) {

  x <- fread(cnr_file)

  if (!"gene" %in% colnames(x)) {
    stop("No 'gene' column found in: ", cnr_file)
  }

  call_col <- grep("\\.Corrected_Call$", colnames(x), value = TRUE)

  if (length(call_col) == 0) {
    stop("No '.Corrected_Call' column found in: ", cnr_file)
  }

  if (length(call_col) > 1) {
    stop("More than one '.Corrected_Call' column found in: ", cnr_file)
  }

  x %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      sample_id = sample_id,
      Patient_Identifier = patient_id,

      # Use corrected CNV call directly from annotated CNR
      cnv_state = as.character(.data[[call_col]]),

      # Clean gene column
      gene = as.character(gene),
      gene = str_replace_all(gene, "\\s+", "")
    ) %>%
    separate_rows(gene, sep = ",|;") %>%
    mutate(
      gene = str_trim(gene),
      cnv_state = str_trim(cnv_state),
      cnv_state = str_to_upper(cnv_state),
      cnv_state = if_else(is.na(cnv_state) | cnv_state == "", "NEUT", cnv_state)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      gene %in% genes_of_interest
    ) %>%
    group_by(Patient_Identifier, sample_id, gene) %>%
    summarise(
      # Collapse only within same sample-gene
      # This does not collapse longitudinal samples.
      cnv_state = collapse_sample_gene(cnv_state),
      n_segments = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

cnv_long <- pmap_dfr(
  list(
    cnr_manifest$cnr_file,
    cnr_manifest$sample_id,
    cnr_manifest$Patient_Identifier
  ),
  read_one_cnr
)

# Add missing sample-gene combinations as NEUT
# This guarantees every plotted sample has all genes of interest.
cnv_complete <- expand_grid(
  sample_id = cnr_manifest$sample_id,
  gene = genes_of_interest
) %>%
  left_join(
    cnr_manifest %>% select(sample_id, Patient_Identifier),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cnv_long,
    by = c("Patient_Identifier", "sample_id", "gene")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cnv_state = if_else(is.na(cnv_state), "NEUT", cnv_state)
  )

cat("========== CNV state summary ==========\n")
cnv_complete %>%
  count(cnv_state, name = "n_sample_gene_calls") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sample_gene_calls)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r make-cnv-matrix}
# ===============================
# Make CNV heatmap matrix
# Rows = genes
# Columns = longitudinal samples
# ===============================

sample_order <- sample_annot %>%
  arrange(Patient_Identifier, draw_sort, sample_id) %>%
  pull(sample_id)

cnv_mat <- cnv_complete %>%
  mutate(
    gene = factor(gene, levels = genes_of_interest),
    sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = sample_order)
  ) %>%
  select(gene, sample_id, cnv_state) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_id,
    values_from = cnv_state,
    values_fill = "NEUT"
  ) %>%
  arrange(gene)

cnv_mat_df <- as.data.frame(cnv_mat)
rownames(cnv_mat_df) <- as.character(cnv_mat_df$gene)
cnv_mat_df$gene <- NULL

cnv_mat_df <- cnv_mat_df[genes_of_interest, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

cat("========== Heatmap matrix dimension ==========\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(cnv_mat_df), "\n")
cat("Samples:", ncol(cnv_mat_df), "\n")
```

```{r heatmap-annotation}
# ===============================
# Heatmap annotation
# ===============================

annot_df <- sample_annot %>%
  arrange(Patient_Identifier, draw_sort, sample_id) %>%
  select(
    sample_id,
    Patient_Identifier,
    Histology_group,
    Molecular_subtype_clean,
    Tumor_Fraction_percent
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(annot_df) <- as.character(annot_df$sample_id)

# CNV colors
cnv_cols <- c(
  "HLAMP" = "#8B0000",
  "AMP"   = "#D73027",
  "GAIN"  = "#FC8D59",
  "NEUT"  = "grey90",
  "HETD"  = "#91BFDB",
  "HOMD"  = "#4575B4",
  "MIXED" = "purple"
)

histology_cols <- c(
  "Ductal" = "#4DBBD5",
  "Lobular" = "#E64B35",
  "Mixed Ductal and Lobular" = "#00A087",
  "other" = "grey70"
)

subtype_cols <- c(
  "HR+/HER2-" = "#3C5488",
  "HR+/HER2+" = "#F39B7F",
  "HR-/HER2+" = "#8491B4",
  "HR-/HER2-" = "#91D1C2",
  "Unknown" = "grey70"
)

tfx_col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, 10, 50, 100),
  c("white", "lightgrey", "orange", "red")
)

top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Histology = annot_df$Histology_group,
  Subtype = annot_df$Molecular_subtype_clean,
  TFx_percent = pmin(annot_df$Tumor_Fraction_percent, 50),

  col = list(
    Histology = histology_cols,
    Subtype = subtype_cols,
    TFx_percent = tf_col_fun
  ),

  na_col = "grey90",

  # changes the displayed annotation name on the left side
  annotation_label = c(
    Histology = "Histology",
    Subtype = "Subtype",
    TFx_percent = "TFx (in %)"
  ),

  show_legend = c(
    Histology = TRUE,
    Subtype = TRUE,
    TFx_percent = TRUE
  ),

  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Histology = list(title = "Histology"),
    Subtype = list(title = "Subtype"),
    TFx_percent = list(
      title = "Tumor fraction (%)",
      at = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50),
      labels = c("0", "10", "20", "30", "40", "≥50")
    )
  ),

  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_annotation_name = TRUE
)
```

```{r patient-boundaries}
# ===============================
# Patient boundary positions for dotted vertical lines
# ===============================

patient_by_sample <- sample_annot %>%
  arrange(Patient_Identifier, draw_sort, sample_id) %>%
  pull(Patient_Identifier)

patient_runs <- rle(patient_by_sample)

boundary_positions <- cumsum(patient_runs$lengths)
boundary_positions <- boundary_positions[-length(boundary_positions)]

cat("========== Patient boundary positions ==========\n")
print(boundary_positions)
```

```{r plot-heatmap-pdf, fig.width=18, fig.height=7}
# ===============================
# Plot heatmap as PDF
# ===============================

ht <- Heatmap(
  as.matrix(cnv_mat_df),
  name = "CNV state",
  col = cnv_cols,
  top_annotation = top_ha,

  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 90,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),

  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "CNV state",
    at = c("HLAMP", "AMP", "GAIN", "NEUT", "HETD", "HOMD", "MIXED")
  )
)

pdf(out_pdf, width = 18, height = 7)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = TRUE
)

decorate_heatmap_body("CNV state", {
  n_cols <- ncol(cnv_mat_df)

  for (b in boundary_positions) {
    grid.lines(
      x = unit(c(b / n_cols, b / n_cols), "npc"),
      y = unit(c(0, 1), "npc"),
      gp = gpar(lty = 3, lwd = 1.2, col = "black")
    )
  }
})

dev.off()

cat("Saved PDF:\n", out_pdf, "\n")
```
